text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Fan Appreciation Festival.
If I recall, Hishi Akebono said she was entering the sumo tournament.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading to the venue to cheer her on—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Teyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Overarm throw! Hishi Akebono wins!
—Advancing to the finals is confirmed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The venue seemed to be buzzing with great excitement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer-san!
You came to watch~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right!
They were super happy with it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I've always loved sumo too, so I couldn't help but get all hyped up~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Doing it really is totally different from just watching.
Grappling chest-to-chest is so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's come to cheer us on,
so we've gotta make the finals the hottest match ever!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! I always watch your races
and your Umasta Lives!
Please do your best in the finals...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah, so many people are cheering for me!
Thank you~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Look forward to today's bout too, okay?♪
I'll do my best, so cheer for me~!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And finally, the finals of the sumo tournament were about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter the time or place, I will never give up on victory!
Now, let us compete~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm gonna give it my all too, here I gooo~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: —Hakkeyoi, nokotta!

text_block_list.name: Bono & Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Hngnnnnn~~!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're locked in a dead heat!
It's a pure test of strength, a battle of brawn!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
K-Kawakami-chan!
You've got some serious guts!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're the one who's
p-powerful, Akebono-san...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: —Right here!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono takes the outside grip first!
Can she force her out? Will it be a frontal force-out?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess...!
Even when all hope is lost, one must fight through with sheer willpower!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, she turns it around—an overarm throw!
Kawakami Princess wins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! So frustrating~!
But that was super fun~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Kawakami-chan, you're so strong~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, well, Akebono-san was just so
strong that I lost myself in the heat of the moment—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I might have thrown that with too much force.
Are you alright?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! It's totally fine~! In fact,
I was super happy that you threw it with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So let's compete again sometime, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
B-By all means!
Let us clash head-on again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did their bond deepen through the bout...?
A loud round of applause enveloped the two as they exchanged a firm, passionate handshake!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: D... Do your best, Hishi Akebono...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Yorikiri—!
Hishi Akebono wins!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~!
Kawakami-chan was so strong~!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan A
text_block_list.text:
She really is amazing!
That heated bout was so moving!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan B
text_block_list.text: I'll keep cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks for enjoying it!
I'm counting on you from now on too☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!
C-Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You know, I could hear your cheers~!
It made me so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing your voice gave me the strength to give it my all~!
Hehe, you're amazing. Thank you so much~!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: N-No, not at all...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know what? Actually, we're gonna hold
a little chanko nabe party right here after this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to drop by anytime!
And make sure you eat till you're full before heading home♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: H-H-Hyeees!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, then I've gotta get ready right away!
Could you lend me a hand, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "We've prepared about 100 servings, so it's a bit much for me. Would you mind helping me carry it~?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Is it still not enough after all?
choice_data_list: No. You really worked hard on the preparations.
No. You really worked hard on the preparations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! That's right! Actually, I prepped it last night, you see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Since I finally get to meet all the fans, I want them to eat something delicious before heading home~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chankonabe gathering held afterward
seemed to serve as a wonderful exchange with the fans.
